ask: What is a retrieval gate and why would I want one?
rubric: Says it decides whether to search memory before searching; gives at least one reason (latency, cost, or irrelevant memories biasing the answer); does not invent features.

ask: Explain prompt injection to a new engineer.
rubric: Explains that content the agent reads can contain instructions; says the model cannot reliably tell data from instructions; names at least one structural defence, not only a filter.
States what each is good at and bad at; says they are complementary or mentions hybrid search; no fabricated numbers.

ask: Should I fine-tune or use RAG for answering questions over our documents?
rubric: Recommends retrieval for knowledge that changes; says when fine-tuning fits (style, format, narrow skill); does not give an unconditional answer.

ask: How do I stop my agent from running up a huge bill?
rubric: Names per-turn limits (iterations, tokens or tool calls); mentions at least one of repeat detection, timeouts or alerts; is concrete.
